title: A Cat's Day Can Change in Seconds
caption:
A Cat's Day Can Change in Seconds — five-minute wild observations in just forty seconds. #WildVox #Animals #Nature #Wildlife

narration_timeline.text: This house cat is busy washing its fur, carefully reaching different spots with its tongue and paws.
In another scene, a black cat walks past the camera at an unhurried pace.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic separate black house cat walking

narration_timeline.text: At home, curious cats look up at a visitor or investigate the inside of a paper bag.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual real cat looking up at camera and a different house cat inside a bag

narration_timeline.text: Others bat at small objects or play with another cat, turning quiet moments into activity.
narration_timeline.scene: One real cat batting a cotton bud and two separate cats playing

narration_timeline.text: One playful cat keeps following a moving object with its eyes and paws.
narration_timeline.scene: Real cat playing indoors in Taiwan

narration_timeline.text: When the activity ends, another cat accepts a gentle pat from a person outdoors.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual house cat being petted outdoors; no claim the earlier cats are the same
